title: Foundation: Fix client API types, paths, and socket events
description: Fix client lib/api.ts paths (nested -> flat), types (match server schema), and socket.ts event names (join:project/join:session). Prerequisite for all frontend work.

title: Fix client API types and paths to match server
description: Rewrite lib/api.ts: fix paths from nested (/projects/:id/epics) to flat (/api/epics?project_id=X). Fix types to match server schema (bead_epic_id, ui_status not title/status). Fix response shapes.

title: Fix socket client event names
description: Change lib/socket.ts: joinRoom/leaveRoom to use join:project, join:session, leave:session events. Add typed event listeners matching server SocketEventMap.

title: Foundation: test infrastructure + project docs
description: Integration test DB isolation (create/cleanup per run), Playwright e2e setup, expand CLAUDE.md and README.md with comprehensive guidelines.
close_reason: Integration test DB isolation (createTestDb + cleanAllTables), Playwright e2e setup, comprehensive CLAUDE.md and README.md guidelines. 110 unit + 13 integration tests passing.

title: Phase 5: Shared Memory + Notifications
description: CM rules management UI (TechLead), Agent Mail thread viewer, CASS session indexing, webhook dispatch (Slack/Discord), in-app + browser push notifications.

title: Rules route: CM rules CRUD proxy
description: GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /rules. Backed by knowledge_rules table + CM sync. TechLead-only write access via requireRole. Categories: coding, security, testing, architecture, general.

title: Mail route and webhooks route
description: Mail: GET /mail/threads (proxy to Agent Mail), GET /mail/threads/:id (thread detail). Webhooks: CRUD for webhook_configs, POST /test (send test payload).

title: Wire notifications and webhooks into lifecycle events
description: Session complete -> notify owner + webhook. PR ready -> notify PM/TechLead. Question waiting -> notify session owner. Merge -> notify team. CASS index after session complete.

title: Rules management UI
description: Table with category filter, confidence slider, maturity badges. Create/edit dialog. Approve/deprecate actions. TechLead role check. Helpful/harmful count display.

title: Notification bell, webhook config, and mail viewer
description: Header bell with unread count + dropdown. Mark read/all. Browser Notification API. Webhook config forms in settings. Agent Mail thread viewer (list + detail).

title: Phase 3: Execution Engine
description: 12-step agent spawn flow: scope gate, git branch, Agent Mail register, CM context, CASS search, context assembly, spawn, NDJSON streaming, Q&A modes (pause/auto/hybrid), queue management, crash recovery.

title: Spike: Claude CLI stdin/stdout Q&A protocol
description: Spawn claude with --output-format=stream-json, trigger AskUserQuestion. Document: NDJSON event type for questions, stdin answer format, detection patterns. Write findings to .spikes/.

title: Agents page with session list
description: Running, queued, completed sections. Session cards with agent name, epic, runtime, turns, last tool. View/Cancel/Promote buttons. Running count vs max display.

title: AskUserQuestion dialog and AlertBar
description: Modal on session:question event with question text, options, context. Global AlertBar below header when any agent has waiting_input status. Pulsing animation, click to navigate.

title: Spike: Crash recovery PID monitoring
description: Test process.kill(pid, 0) reliability on macOS. Find session log file location (~/.claude/). Test session log format recovery. Write findings to .spikes/.

title: AgentQueue service
description: enqueue(), processQueue() (check running vs max_concurrent_agents, pick by priority), cancel(), promote(). SQLite transactions for atomicity. Emit queue:updated via Socket.IO.

title: ContextBuilder service
description: Assemble prompt from 6 sources: epic desc+AC, CM rules (cmClient.getContext), CASS learnings (cassService.search), beads context (bvService.robotTriage), repo structure (file tree), guardrails. Each source try/catch for graceful degradation.

title: Spawn orchestration: full 12-step flow
description: Wire full flow: scope gate check -> git branch -> Agent Mail register -> CM context -> CASS search -> ContextBuilder -> AgentManager.spawn(). Integrate into sessions POST route. Update session status through lifecycle.

title: NDJSON event storage and Socket.IO broadcast
description: Modify AgentManager onEvent: store in session_events table, emit session:event via emitToSession(). Track progress stats (turns, tools, elapsed), emit session:progress every 10s. On completion: emit session:lifecycle.

title: Q&A stdin piping with 3 modes
description: Change stdio to ['pipe','pipe','pipe']. Maintain Map<sessionId, stdin>. Detect AskUserQuestion in NDJSON, emit session:question. Implement pause/auto/hybrid modes. answerQuestion() writes to stdin.

title: Crash recovery on startup
description: recoverOrphanedSessions() on server start. Check PIDs of 'running' sessions. Recover events from ~/.claude/ session logs. Handle detached state.

title: AgentStreamView component
description: Terminal-like display parsing session:event socket data. Show system messages, assistant text, tool use/result (collapsible), errors. Auto-scroll with pause-on-scroll-up. Typing indicator.

title: Phase 2: Capture + Triage + Epic Dashboard
description: Capture inbox sidebar, Epic Kanban board (dnd-kit), Epic side panel. Wire Socket.IO emits into captures/epics routes. Wire BeadsService into epics route. TanStack Query hooks with socket invalidation.

title: Wire Socket.IO emits into captures and epics routes
description: Add emitToProject() calls in captures.ts (after create/update/delete) and epics.ts (after create/update). Emit capture:created, epic:created, epic:updated events.

title: Wire BeadsService into epics route
description: On epic GET, call beadsService.show(bead_epic_id) to hydrate title, priority, type, labels from br. On epic list, batch-fetch bead data. Handle BeadsService errors gracefully.

title: TanStack Query hooks for captures and epics
description: Create useCaptures(projectId) and useEpics(projectId) TanStack Query hooks. Add socket listener hooks that invalidate query keys on capture:created, epic:created, epic:updated events.

title: CaptureInbox sidebar component
description: Collapsible panel in sidebar. List pending captures with create form. Triage actions: create epic, defer, dismiss. Badge count. Real-time updates via socket.

title: EpicCard component
description: Display title, priority badge, type icon, progress bar (nested beads completion), agent status indicator, assignee avatar. Card states: default, running, waiting Q&A, has PR.

title: Kanban board with dnd-kit
description: 5-column Kanban (Nháp, Sẵn sàng, Đang thực hiện, Đang xem xét, Hoàn thành) with @dnd-kit/core + @dnd-kit/sortable. Drag card between columns triggers PATCH epic ui_status. Optimistic updates with rollback.

title: EpicSidePanel (Sheet)
description: Click epic card opens shadcn Sheet. Shows: description, acceptance criteria, nested beads list, sessions list, git branches, PR link. Action buttons: Start Session, Edit.

title: Board filters, sort, and triage flow
description: Filter by type, labels, priority. Sort within columns. Search. Triage capture -> Epic dialog with enrichment (title, priority, description). Creates bead via BeadsService then epic in DB.

title: Express API: auth, rbac, routes (auth, captures, epics, sessions, projects, notifications, health)
close_reason: Completed: auth/RBAC middleware + 7 route files with 41 tests, all passing

title: Phase 4: Quality Gate
description: Pre-push validation (tests, build, typecheck, forbidden patterns), PR creation via gh CLI, Code Review Agent auto-spawn, review UI with diff viewer, feedback loop, squash merge workflow.

title: ValidationService: pre-push checks
description: Run tests, typecheck (tsc --noEmit), build, forbidden pattern scan (merge conflict markers, console.log, .only, HACK). Returns structured result per check. Max 5min timeout per check.

title: PrService: gh CLI wrapper for PR lifecycle
description: createPr(repoPath, branch, title, body) via gh pr create. mergePr(repoPath, prNumber) via gh pr merge --squash. getPrStatus(). Multi-repo: all-or-nothing push.

title: Post-completion flow: validate, push, PR, review agent
description: Agent completes -> run ValidationService -> if pass: git push -> gh pr create -> update session pr_url -> spawn Code Review Agent -> emit pr:event. If fail: status=validation_failed, emit event.

title: Review route + merge workflow
description: GET /review/:sessionId (diff + AI comments). POST /comment (human comment -> agent fix cycle). POST /merge (gh pr merge --squash + br close + beads sync + git commit .beads/ + cleanup branches).

title: PR Review page with DiffViewer
description: Split pane: diff viewer (react-diff-viewer-continued) left, review panel right. File list, AI review summary (UBS pass/fail, security, standards). Inline AI comments at file:line.

title: Merge UI and feedback loop
description: Approve/Merge buttons (TechLead only) with confirmation. Send to Agent button for fix cycle. Status badges. Comment thread with reply. Max 3 iteration limit.

title: Phase 6: Graph + Deployment
description: bv dependency graph (React Flow + dagre), Cloudflare Tunnel + Zero Trust, PM2 config, role-based dashboard views.

title: Graph route: bv data proxy
description: GET /graph?project_id=X calls bvService.robotPlan(), transforms to React Flow node/edge format with status coloring. GET /graph/triage and /graph/plan endpoints.

title: GraphView component with React Flow + dagre
description: React Flow canvas with dagre auto-layout. Node colors: green=ready, blue=in_progress, red=blocked, gray=open. Critical path highlighting. Legend, filters, minimap. Click node -> epic detail.

title: PM2 config and Cloudflare Tunnel setup
description: ecosystem.config.cjs for PM2 (single instance, SQLite-safe). cloudflared config for tunnel. Cloudflare Access JWT verification middleware. Dev mode bypass.
